paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Edom Gawtna
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Seir tang masuan inla, atung ah thu gen in. Akiang ah,
english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, Aw Seir tang, ka hon dou hi, na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka hon hihgawp in mulkimhuaitak in ka hon bawl ding.
english: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

paite: Na khopite ka hihse ding a, na kigawp ding; huan TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding."
english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Na nitna uh gawtna nanungpen a asiat ni ua Israel inkote namsau thilhihtheihna a na lat a, na kinakpih gige ziak in,
english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

paite: kei ka hin bang in, sisan a ding in ka hon bawl ding a, sisan in ahon delh ding; sisan na huat louh ziak in sisan in ahon delh ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

paite: Hichi in Seir tang bel mulkimhuaitak a bawl in ka sugawp ding; atung a mi vialvakte ka tawpsak vek ding hi.
english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

paite: Atangte amah mithahte in ka dimsak ding; na tangte ah, na phaizang leh na lui phaizang kuakte ah namsau a thahte apuk phengphung ding uh.
english: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

paite: Ka hon sugawp den ding a, na khopite luah in a-om kei ding; huan kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding hi.
english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA zaw a-om gige na a, "Hiai nam nihte leh gam nihte kei a ahi ding a, ka tang mai ding uh," na chih ziak in.
english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although Yahweh was there,

paite: Kei ka hin bang in chih, Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, na hehna bang zel leh na huatna ziak a hazatna na suklatdan bang zel in ka hih ding ahi; na tungthu ka ngaihtuah hun chiang in alak uah ka hihlang ding hi.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

paite: "Hihgawp in a-omta ua, ka kiang ah piak in a-omta uh," chi a Israel tangte na gensiatna tengteng kei TOUPA'N ka za vek chih na thei ding hi.
english: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

paite: Ka tung ah na kam in na kiliansak in ka tung ah thu na tamsak a, ka za vek hi.
english: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Lei pumpi kipahna ding in ka hon sugawp ding hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

paite: Israelte gouluah asiat ziak a na kipah mah bang in na tung ah ka hih ding; Aw Seir tang leh Edom tengteng, avek in akisegawp ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
